course_name_original: UE Algorithmes : analyse des algorithmes, complexité
prerequisites: Basic data structures: sequences and trees (array and linked representations)

learning_outcomes.text: Algorithm analysis: algorithm cost, complexity, recurrence equations, average case analysis, introduction to problem complexity
Abstract types: formal definition, arrays and hash tables, sequential structures (stacks, queues, priority queues)
Tree structures: Trees, binary trees, properties, search trees, partially ordered trees (heap structure)
Classic problems: "union-find" algorithms, tree-based dictionaries, coding trees (Huffman algorithm), B-trees, 2D trees and quadtrees

syllabus_topics: Elementary data structures: stack, queue, heap, trees
Algorithmic methods: divide and conquer, greedy algorithms
Classic algorithms: quicksort, binary search trees, heapsort, Prim's algorithm
bibliography: Introduction à l'algorithmique par Cormen, Leisserson, Rivest et Stein Dunod 2002
Algorithmes en Java, par Sedgewick, Pearson Education
institution: Institut National Polytechnique De Grenoble — Licence Informatique (UGA)
